reason: I already pay for mentalism apps like this, and a Hebrew one I can use at Israeli birthdays and events is something I don't have. 99 shekels once is less than what I charge for ten minutes of a show, so if the free tricks hold up I'll buy it to compare with what I own.
objection: It installs from a website, not the App Store, and I pay by card on some site I've never heard of. I also worry whether a browser app is reliable enough in front of a paying crowd, offline, when the reveal has to work every single time.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks glitch or look fake in the gallery or calculator on my own phone, or the payment page looks sketchy, I won't pay.
